- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". - loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Found it.

## Findings

The PostgreSQL database driver is implemented by a struct named **`DB`** (package-qualified: `postgres.DB`).

- **Struct name:** `DB`
- **File:** `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go` (defined at line 16)
- **Interface implemented:** `store.Driver`, defined in `/bench/repo/store/driver.go` (line 10)

### Details

The struct is defined as:
```go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

The constructor `NewDB(profile *profile.Profile) (store.Driver, error)` (line 21) returns it explicitly typed as `store.Driver`, and it registers the PostgreSQL backend via the imported `github.com/lib/pq` driver (`sql.Open("postgres", ...)`).

### Naming-convention note

This repo does not use names like `Postgres`, `PostgreSQL`, or `Pg` for the struct. Instead it uses a **per-package `DB` struct** convention, with the database engine distinguished by the package/directory rather than the type name. There are three parallel implementations of the same `store.Driver` interface, all with the identical struct name `DB`:

- `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go` — PostgreSQL (line 16)
- `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` — SQLite (line 16)
- `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/mysql.go` — MySQL (line 14)

The interface method implementations for the PostgreSQL driver are spread across the other files in `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/` (e.g. `memo.go`, `user.go`, `attachment.go`, etc.), each defining methods on `*DB`.
